bind fork/snip message lookup to the caller's session

`forkSession`/`snipSession`'s adapter parameter now requires `findBySessionIdAndId` where it
previously required `findById`. Any caller passing the real `questRepository` is unaffected, since
`IChatHistoryItemRepository` has carried that method since #1755. A hand-rolled minimal adapter
that only implements `findById` will fail to compile against this patch.
